facts.text: Cloud migration setup must be completed before data replication can run
Run diagnostics first to identify and fix issues before actual replication starts
Open Cloud Migration Management page and select Run data replication to start migrating data
Monitor progress by checking Migration Log list and status fields on Cloud Migration Management page
When data replication is stopped, any data already migrated remains in the online database
Generally only changed data since last replication is replicated on rerun
Data replication cannot stop mid-table, waits until current table completes
